ko.summary: 스킬팩을 CineForge 명령으로 확인·설치·전환할 수 있습니다. 업데이트는 직접 실행할 때만 일어나고, 진행 중인 프로젝트는 처음 고정한 팩을 계속 씁니다.
added: `cineforge skills update --check`: 최신 스킬팩 릴리스와 변경 내용을 확인합니다(아무것도 쓰지 않음).
`cineforge skills update --yes`: 내려받은 아카이브를 SHA-256으로 검증한 뒤 버전별 폴더에 설치하고, 새 프로젝트의 기본 팩으로 지정합니다.
`cineforge skills list`, `cineforge skills use <버전>`, `cineforge skills use --default`로 설치된 버전을 보고 전환합니다.
improved: 활성 버전을 바꿔도 기존 프로젝트는 저장된 버전 폴더에서 고정된 팩을 찾습니다.
`CINEFORGE_SKILL_PACK`이 설정돼 있으면 활성 버전보다 우선한다는 경고를 보여 줍니다.
compat: 설치 위치: `~/.local/share/cineforge/skill-packs/`(XDG_DATA_HOME 우선). 이전 버전 폴더는 지우지 않습니다.
Contents Production Skills 2.64 이상의 릴리스 아카이브를 사용합니다.

en.summary: CineForge can now check, install and switch skill packs. Updates happen only when you run them, and projects in progress keep the pack they were pinned to.
added: `cineforge skills update --check` shows the latest skill pack release and what changed, without writing anything.
`cineforge skills update --yes` verifies the archive's SHA-256, installs it into a versioned folder and makes it the default for new projects.
`cineforge skills list`, `cineforge skills use <version>` and `cineforge skills use --default` show and switch installed versions.
improved: After switching the active version, existing projects still find their pinned pack among the stored versions.
A warning appears when `CINEFORGE_SKILL_PACK` overrides the active version.
compat: Install location: `~/.local/share/cineforge/skill-packs/` (XDG_DATA_HOME first). Older version folders are never deleted.
Uses release archives of Contents Production Skills 2.64 or later.

cineforge.compat:
설치 위치: `~/.local/share/cineforge/skill-packs/`(XDG_DATA_HOME 우선). 이전 버전 폴더는 지우지 않습니다.
Contents Production Skills 2.64 이상의 릴리스 아카이브를 사용합니다.

ko.summary: 캐릭터 대사를 기본적으로 영상 모델이 같은 요청 안에서 음성과 함께 생성합니다. 별도 음성(TTS)은 요청할 때만 계획됩니다.
improved: 대사는 영상 요청의 오디오 구획(화자·대사·고정 음성 정체성)에 들어가며, 별도 `dialogue` 작업을 만들지 않습니다.
모델의 네이티브 오디오 지원 여부는 실행 직전에 확인하도록 `UNVERIFIED`로 기록합니다.
별도 음성이 필요하면 `cineforge new ... --external-voice`를 씁니다. 무대사(`--no-speech`)는 그대로 무음입니다.

en.summary: Character dialogue is now generated natively by the video model in the same request. A separate voice (TTS) is planned only on request.
improved: Dialogue goes into the video request's audio section (speaker, line, fixed voice identity); no separate `dialogue` job is created.
Native audio support is recorded as `UNVERIFIED` and checked right before execution.
Use `cineforge new ... --external-voice` for a separate voice. `--no-speech` stays silent.

en.summary:
CineForge now reads installed v1 production skill packs. Existing projects keep their original pack pin; only new projects adopt a different compatible pack. Stage outputs, approvals, and execution authority remain under CineForge control. Projects created before pack pinning continue in legacy mode.

Install the wheel and [Contents Production Skills 2.64](https://github.com/DeclanJeon/contents-production-skills/releases/tag/v2.64). Set `CINEFORGE_SKILL_PACK` to the extracted skill pack root and confirm with `cineforge skills`. Keep older versioned pack directories for projects that are still in progress.

New projects use a stable ASCII project ID instead of a prefix of the request.

- Interactive CLI prompts for a project ID; non-interactive callers pass `--project-id`.
- Host routing guides agents to choose a short English ID. Existing project folders and work titles are unchanged.
- The CLI wheel includes routing evaluation data.

Adds a CineForge v1 pack adapter and verified file inventory. Stage owners, routes, and craft references can now be updated independently of CineForge. The adapter does not grant execution authority.

Download the installed pack archive and its SHA-256 file, verify the archive, extract it to a stable versioned directory, and set `CINEFORGE_SKILL_PACK` to the extracted `contents-production-skills-2.64` directory. Use `cineforge skills` with CineForge 0.1.4 or later to check the installation.
